licence_basis: Free analytical application / limited original-record redistribution; Source: UN Comtrade. Raw responses excluded. See https://uncomtrade.org/docs/re-dissemination-of-data/
caveats: World/aggregate partners excluded from country rows; shares may sum below 100%.
ISO mapping follows UN Comtrade partner reference, not generic numeric ISO codes. partner_scope preserves customs-area differences (e.g. France includes Monaco).
Unknown transport mode; geography is not a route.
Native HS revisions retained; wheat under HS2007 or earlier includes seed, including Kenya 2013.
Country absence is not a proven zero; unsuccessful commodity-years omitted.

commodity_id.description: Standardized commodity identifier in national basket

flow_direction.description: Trade flow direction: Import or Export
flow_direction.lineage: UN Comtrade flowCode (M mapped to Import, X mapped to Export)

year.description: Calendar year of bilateral trade report

month.description: Calendar month of observation (null for annual aggregates)
month.null_semantics: null for all annual records; monthly data not acquired

partner_iso3.description: Trading partner ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code

partner_name.description: Official partner country or territory display name

partner_comtrade_codes.description: UN Comtrade numeric partner area code(s)

partner_scope.description: Scope notes on customs territory inclusions and exceptions
partner_scope.null_semantics: null where standard sovereign territory applies
partner_scope.lineage: UN Comtrade partner reference custom area notes

corridor_type.null_semantics: always set to Unknown (transport not observed) to prevent transport inference
corridor_type.lineage: Scientific rule D-7 / Handover §1: no transport inference

volume_t.description: Bilateral trade volume in metric tonnes
volume_t.null_semantics: null where net weight was not reported or zero

value_usd.description: Bilateral trade value in nominal US dollars

unit_price_usd_t.description: Implied bilateral unit price in nominal USD per metric tonne
unit_price_usd_t.null_semantics: null where volume is absent or zero

partner_share_pct.description: Partner share of reported World trade value: 100 * value_usd / world_value_usd
partner_share_pct.null_semantics: null where world_value_usd is absent or zero

share_basis.description: Denominator specification used for partner share computation
share_basis.lineage: UN Comtrade reported World total specification

world_value_usd.description: Total trade value reported for World partner (partner code 0)
world_value_usd.null_semantics: null where World partner was not reported

hs_codes.description: Harmonized System commodity code(s) queried for this record
hs_codes.lineage: BASKET HS codes queried from UN Comtrade

hs_editions.description: Harmonized System nomenclature edition(s) active for reporting year
hs_editions.lineage: UN Comtrade classificationCode (e.g. H3, H4, H5, H6)

weight_estimated.description: Flag indicating whether net weight was estimated by UN Comtrade
